main_claim: The full strict unit graph on three distinct centres and their complete unit circles is four-colourable whenever one centre-pair distance is at least three.
domination_corollary: Every dominating triple in a five-chromatic plane unit-distance graph is independent and has diameter strictly less than three.
fresh_family: exact distance-three equality boundary, with arbitrary third centre and full continuum support
new_stop_boundary: all three centre separations strictly below three and different from one
